strings.dlg.c3p2.night_01.share: Morozov. Good. I was hoping you had found a note too.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_01.report: Stop right there. – Morozov. Of all people.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_04.cafe: Mine was in Russian, same hand. She never came to the café. I waited until closing time.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_04.alone: Mine was in Russian, same hand. This morning I wanted to search alone. Now she’s writing to me.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_05.search: She isn’t here. I asked after her all evening. At the Palace nobody knows anything. Or says so.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_11.evidence: Who supplied paragraph four. Whether Emil’s construction series has a file here. And what became of my drawings.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_11.suspicion: Who supplied paragraph four – in Berlin I received no answer. And what became of my drawings.
strings.dlg.c3p2.night_13.report: At the sorting table. And, Morozov: I reported you today. You should know that before we begin.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cmp_03.share: Because you started this morning. Elena’s note. Once you’ve started, it’s easier to start again.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cmp_03.report: Because you reported me today. Whoever reports lays his papers out first.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cmp_04.evidence: Seating plan, log, impression. And Emil’s copy from Berlin: there, C-17 is a construction series.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cmp_04.suspicion: Seating plan, log, impression. Nothing more – whoever asks officially in Berlin gets no copies.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cmp_05.irina: Weighbill, departure board, travel order. And the working timetable from Karsk – Irina copied it out for me.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cmp_05.secrecy: Weighbill, departure board, travel order. I copied the working timetable from Karsk myself. In secret.
strings.dlg.c3p2.par_06.report: I thought your people were taking our wagons. Your reporting me today fitted that nicely.
strings.dlg.c3p2.par_11.suspicion: Ours is called the Registration Office. What comes after, nobody names. I asked about it once. Once.
strings.dlg.c3p2.dsk_02.trust: I draw desks, Morozov. But for you I’ll push one.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cht_02.distrust: And when I’m up there – how do you know I’ll give you a hand?
strings.dlg.c3p2.cht_03.distrust: I don’t. That’s why you go first.
strings.dlg.c3p2.cht_05.distrust: It is. The only one I have. – Go!
strings.dlg.c3p2.snw_06.secrecy: He crossed the Line in 1957. Nobody in Karsk knows we were friends. Now you know.
strings.dlg.c3p2.snw_11.report: Kessler is over there by the wagons. I brought him in today. With the whole file I won’t get past him.
strings.choice.c3d.admit_plan.report: Tell him Sheet 7 is your drawing – after reporting him to Kessler, you owe him that
strings.choice.c3d.pocket_plan.evidence: Put Sheet 7 with Emil’s copy and say: ‘An office in Berlin.’
strings.choice.c3d.pocket_plan.suspicion: Pocket Sheet 7 – in Berlin one doesn’t ask twice – and say: ‘An office in Berlin.’
strings.choice.c3g.split_by_language.secrecy: Split by language – and keep to yourself who Pjotr is
strings.choice.c3g.swap_halves.trust: Split crosswise: you entrust him with Pjotr’s name, he entrusts you with his people
strings.choice.c3g.hide_for_elena.elena: Put the list in Elena’s coat, ticket 27 – she will come
strings.dlg.c3p2.react.admit_plan.report: This morning you report me, tonight you tell me the truth. You are thorough, Adler.
strings.dlg.c3p2.react.admit_plan: You drew a room. Someone else put the bench in it. – Thank you for saying so.
strings.dlg.c3p2.react.pocket_plan: An office in Berlin. With us, too, it’s always offices that do the drawing.
strings.dlg.c3p2.react.split_by_language: Each carries what he can read. And each can bear witness – in his own language.
strings.dlg.c3p2.react.swap_halves: Pjotr’s name rides with me to Berlin. Nobody will look for it on me. – I’ll take care of it, Morozov.
strings.dlg.c3p2.react.hide_for_elena: When she comes back, she’ll fetch her coat first. Everyone does. – I’ll take the list there.
